description: Show per-item weight/unit (e.g. 'mircha 250g', 'jharu 3 pcs') EVERYWHERE an order is shown. weight is ALREADY captured onto order lines (Checkout sends weight on both POSTs; routes/orders.ts itemSchema has weight); additively capture unit too (JSON column, no migration), then display a compact, defensive label (name + weight-or-pack) in the customer order view, the admin order view, the jsPDF invoice, and the WhatsApp order message. Empty weight/unit (old orders) must render as the bare name with no blank '()' and no 'undefined'. Independent of FEAT-001.
steps: api-node/src/routes/orders.ts: add `unit: z.string().optional().default('')` to itemSchema next to the existing weight field. No migration (items is a JSON column).

web/src/pages/checkout/Checkout.tsx: add `unit: i.unit ?? ''` to BOTH items.map(...) payloads — the pending POST (~line 411) and the confirm POST (~line 435). Leave the existing `weight: i.weight ?? ''` as-is.

Create web/src/lib/orderItemLabel.ts exporting orderItemSuffix(item) and orderItemLabel(item) for item { name: string; weight?: string; unit?: string; quantity?: number }. orderItemSuffix: trimmed non-empty weight wins (e.g. '250g'); else trimmed non-empty unit yields `${quantity} ${unit}` (e.g. '3 pcs'); else ''. orderItemLabel returns the name, plus ' (' + suffix + ')' ONLY when suffix is non-empty — never a blank '()' or 'undefined'.

web/src/pages/Orders.tsx: import the helper and render the item name + suffix in the order.items.map(...) row (currently `{item.name} \u00d7 {item.quantity}`), e.g. 'Mircha \u2014 250g' / 'Jharu 3 pcs'. Keep the price column unchanged.

web/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: in OrderDetail use the helper in the order.items.map(...) row (currently `{item.name} \u00d7 {item.quantity}`) so each line shows weight/pack. AdminOrderFull extends MyOrder (items already carries weight?); helper reads unit defensively. Keep the amount column unchanged.

web/src/lib/invoice.ts: in the per-item loop append the weight/pack suffix (reuse orderItemSuffix) to the item name text (either 'name (250g)' or a smaller secondary line). Keep the jsPDF layout, ASCII-only output ('Rs. ', no \u20b9/Devanagari) and the splitTextToSize row-height handling. Empty weight/unit => name only.

web/src/pages/checkout/OrderSuccess.tsx: widen PlacedOrder.items to `{ name: string; quantity: number; weight?: string; unit?: string }` (Checkout passes `items: payload.order.items`, which carries weight and now unit). In sendOrderWhatsApp() build each line as `${i+1}. <label> \u00d7 <quantity>` using the shared suffix helper (e.g. 'Mircha 250g x1', 'Jharu 3 pcs x2'). Empty weight/unit => bare name. There is NO server-side order WhatsApp builder; this client-side wa.me share is the only order WhatsApp text.

New orders persist weight AND unit on each line (Checkout payload + itemSchema); old orders with empty weight/unit still render cleanly.
